negative_baseline.finding: Current simplified V17 accepted fabricated episode/signal/causal/delta identities and reached DONE/COMPLETE without an exact V15/V16 execution-generation support chain.

hypothesis: V17 terminalization is valid only when it consumes one coherent pre-existing support chain: exact verified V14 attempt/outcome; exact immutable effect execution-generation fence with durable matching V16 EXECUTION_BOUND and ingress-admission ancestry; complete GWT receiver closure; same-cycle prediction about the exact effect; non-correlated causal credit targeting that effect; and, for learning, an independently admitted CURRENT semantic delta about the exact effect bound to the same causal credit.
strongest_counterhypothesis: The proposed closure may be stricter than necessary, especially for explicit no-learning and post-crash reconciliation. The narrower alternative could waive GWT/causal support under a typed no-learning sentinel, but doing so removes causal workspace provenance from terminalization. Target crash/recovery evidence must decide whether full support is overconstraining.

architecture_delta.title: GO: fuse V17 execution generation with canonical GWT/causal support
changes: Persist exact execution_id, lease_epoch and execution-generation binding hash in V17 re-entry binding.
Require effect execution fence to resolve through matching durable V16 EXECUTION_BOUND and ingress admission credential/session/client ancestry.
Require attention.outcome_ref == exact effect and receiver addressable/delivered/reconstructed/used/local_effect closure.
Require verified same-cycle prediction.subject_id == exact effect.
Reject CORRELATED_ONLY causal credit at both re-entry support and semantic-delta admission boundaries.
Require an independently admitted immutable effect+causal+semantic-delta relation for learning re-entry.
Treat explicit_no_learning as waiving only semantic-delta admission, not GWT/use/causal provenance.
Revalidate the execution/support chain before DONE, verification and recovery COMPLETE.
Preserve additive candidate-only migration/rollback and canonical V14/V15/V16 state.
